arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

p = parse.Parser('{0:d}{1:w}')
print(f'Expression: {p._expression}')
print(f'Fixed fields: {p._fixed_fields}')
print(f'Type conversions: {p._type_conversions}')

import re
m = re.match(p._expression, '42 hello')
if m:
    print(f'Match groups: {m.groups()}')
else:
    print('No match')
"
